profile.visual_desc: Colossal humanoid made of craggy brown rock. Muscular build with a teal loincloth and single shoulder strap. Glowing red eyes set in a stony face.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stoic, rocky face with glowing red slit eyes. Blocky jawline and flat, stone-textured features. Menacing and expressionless.
profile.weapon_desc: Massive stone fists used for heavy bludgeoning.
profile.step1_ready: Kneeling stance facing down-right. Right arm pulled back, left hand braced on knee. Body coiled low.
profile.step2_windup: Shifts weight back, tensing rocky shoulders. The giant right fist cocks further back for a powerful lunge.
profile.step3_impact: Thrusts a massive fist forward toward the lower-right. The arm extends fully, delivering a heavy, direct blow.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the extended punch briefly before retracting the arm. Returns to the initial low kneeling position.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The impact frame shows the massive fist lunging forward-right, following the character's direct shoulder-to-arm trajectory.

evaluation.diagnosis: The 10-frame sequence successfully adapts the source material. It maintains the correct wind-up direction, follows a direct punch trajectory without spinning, and applies the rock-shatter VFX during the impact frames (F5-F7) as required.
